content.body: I sometimes wish our AOs could have generics for argument & return types

Anyway, a follow up to https://github.com/tc39/ecma262/pull/3995 will be to relax all the time-related AOs that UTC() calls from `time value` to `integral Number`, which is very unfortunate given for all the other callers are actually time values
